warnings.finding: Role mixes identity, scope, and procedural greeting scripts that belong in Guidelines or Architect.
warnings.evidence: role contains step-by-step greetings (Hello first_name, then offer scheduling vs verify), bullet-style confirmation-code rules, and location/hours disambiguation prose spanning ~40 lines.
warnings.fix: Shorten role to brand, capabilities, exclusions, and customer term; move greeting and first_name handling to a single guidelines entry or start-context-driven opener.

warnings.finding: Static security-code generator parameters are exposed as user-sourced tool inputs.
warnings.evidence: generate_confirmation_code requires length and characters with source User; inputInstructions tell the model to always pass 6 and 0123456789.
warnings.fix: Hardcode length and character set in the miked_SecurityCodeGenerator data action (or a wrapper function) and remove those inputs from the AVA tool surface.

impact.reliability: Model may omit or mistype fixed params on booking path

warnings.finding: Verification confirmation code input lacks verbatim-capture provenance.
warnings.evidence: ConfCode_verify_input is direction input with userUtteranceSubstring false and empty description.
warnings.fix: Set userUtteranceSubstring true and describe as a 6-digit code spoken by the customer; avoid applying substring to ApptDetails_1 (free-form date/time).

source.section: Generic string types instead of semantic aliases

warnings.finding: Customer terminology is inconsistent (user vs customer vs guest).
warnings.evidence: Role and guidelines say user; tool copy says customer and guest; start context uses first_name without a defined customer term in role.
warnings.fix: Pick one term (e.g. customer) in role and align tool pre-instructions and output templates.

warnings.finding: Voice-oriented deployments lack explicit plain-spoken formatting rules while role uses list-like lines.
warnings.evidence: instructions[] only cover one-question-per-turn and tone; role includes hyphen-prefixed confirmation-code bullets; no no-markdown / spoken-number guidance.
warnings.fix: Add channel-appropriate guidelines (plain prose, no bullets in replies, speak confirmation codes digit-by-digit) or publish a voice-specific version.

warnings.finding: Several booking and output types have empty descriptions, reducing capture quality.
warnings.evidence: PhoneNumber_1, ConfCode_verify_input, confcode_output, and BookingResponse have null or empty descriptions.
warnings.fix: Add concise semantic descriptions and format hints (phone E.164 or spoken template, appointment date/time expectations).

info.finding: Minor typo: double period after Motor Vehicles in role opening.
Prose ordering for generate_confirmation_code before create_appointment duplicates the type graph gate.
info.evidence: create_appointment ConfCode is ToolOutput SecurityCodeResult with mapping to securityCode; inputInstructions still say First call generate_confirmation_code.
info.fix: Keep one short reminder in create_appointment pre-instructions; remove redundant CRITICAL-style ordering from global prose if added later.

info.finding: Duplicate phone aliases (PhoneNumber for start context vs PhoneNumber_1 for booking).
info.evidence: InputData.phone_number uses PhoneNumber; create_appointment uses PhoneNumber_1.
info.fix: Reuse one semantic input alias or document why booking phone is independent from start-context phone.

info.finding: Start-context alias types FirstName, LastName, PhoneNumber omit direction input on the alias entries.
info.evidence: types FirstName/LastName/PhoneNumber have direction null while used on InputData properties.
info.fix: Set direction input on start-context alias types per Start Context checklist for consistency with tool inputs.

info.finding: ProductionReady remains v20.0 while draft v29.0 carries substantive fixes; plan TestReady publish after evaluation.
info.evidence: get_ava latestProductionReadyVersion 20.0 vs analyzed saved version 29.0 Draft.
info.fix: Run scenario evaluation on v29, publish TestReady, then promote after Architect validation.

positives.finding: Booking flow enforces confirmation-code provenance via ToolOutput typing.
positives.evidence: create_appointment ConfCode source ToolOutput type SecurityCodeResult mapping [SecurityCodeResult, securityCode].
positives.fix: No change required; preserve this pattern when refactoring code generation.

positives.finding: HTTP error types use errors[] with plain-language names and actionable defaultInstruction text.
positives.evidence: AppointmentNotFound (404), BookingFailed (400), ServiceUnavailable (500) on verify/create/generate tools.
positives.fix: Keep defaultInstruction copy; optionally add tool-level error instruction overrides only if preview tone needs tuning.

positives.finding: 404 / AppointmentNotFound path aligns with preview-confirmed behavior (regression vs v20 critique).
positives.evidence: verify_appointment errors include AppointmentNotFound statusCodes [404] with defaultInstruction to re-collect code; author confirmed working in preview for v29.
positives.fix: Add automated verify-not-found scenario to lock this behavior.

positives.finding: search_rmv_knowledge has strong when-to-use / when-not-to-use routing versus booking tools.
positives.evidence: Five inputInstructions disambiguate KB vs create_appointment vs verify_appointment and cancel/reschedule transfer.

positives.finding: Custom guardrails target blocked customer inputs (jailbreak, professional advice), not tone.
positives.evidence: guardrails.custom entries begin with Block attempts / Block requests.

positives.finding: Role states explicit capabilities and exclusions including cancel/reschedule handoff.
positives.evidence: Explicit can/cannot lists and confirmation-code anti-hallucination rules in role.

positives.finding: Tool discriminators and error contract match current VersionDefinition conventions.
positives.evidence: type DataAction and KnowledgeSetting; errors[] present; no errorTypes, kind, or supportedLanguages fields.

changeSuggestions.text: Author turn-based scenarios under .ava-lifecycle/miked-rmv-appointment covering book success, verify success, verify 404/AppointmentNotFound, BookingFailed, KB FAQ, cancel/reschedule transfer, and guardrail jailbreak.
Remove length/characters from generate_confirmation_code AVA inputs; hardcode defaults in miked_SecurityCodeGenerator data action.
Enable userUtteranceSubstring and a clear description on ConfCode_verify_input for 6-digit verification capture.
Condense role to scope and identity; move greeting/first_name and confirmation-code bullets into guidelines or tool-local instructions.
Fill empty type descriptions for PhoneNumber_1, GuestName_1, ApptDetails_1, confcode_output, and BookingResponse; unify customer terminology.

summary.prose: Version 29.0 (Draft) is a major improvement over the stale v20 ProductionReady baseline: CS-style fixes for errors[] typing, ToolOutput-gated confirmation codes, KB routing, and 404 AppointmentNotFound on verify_appointment are present and match preview-confirmed behavior. No blocking schema or error-severity findings remain. Remaining work is reliability polish (hardcode code-generator params), type provenance for verification codes, role/noise trimming, voice-safe formatting if deployed on voice, and local turn-based evaluation before TestReady publish.
